_comment: Critical-analysis fix: every SHADeS++ config (including both earlier mask-collapse-weight experiments) trains with noadjust=true, meaning adjust_net -- the mechanism meant to correct for view-dependent illumination when warping the decomposed light field between frames, which matters in endoscopy because the light source is camera-mounted -- has never been exercised. Root cause found: the noadjust=false code path in trainer.py referenced an undefined outputs[('color_warp', 0, frame_id)] tensor (a leftover from before reflectance/light warping replaced a single combined color warp), so enabling it crashed immediately -- fixed in trainer.py (decompose_postprocess) to use reflectance_warp*light_warp instead. This config tests the fixed, now-actually-functional adjust_net path for the first time. mask_ratio_weight is left at its default (0.02) -- the earlier mask-collapse-weight experiments showed that lever isn't the issue (loss_mask_align's BCE term, weight 0.2, dominates it regardless), so this isolates the one new variable.
_models_to_load_comment: adjust_net is deliberately excluded -- v_tau050 never trained it, so it starts from a fresh random init.
